Sooryavanshi smashed 78 off 26 balls, including 7 sixes and 8 fours after a 15-ball fifty. Jurel anchored the chase with an unbeaten 81 off 43, hitting 3 sixes and 8 fours. Read full ArticleWho Won Yesterday IPL Match: RR vs RCBBlistering fifties from Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Dhruv Jurel powered Rajasthan Royals to a six-wicket win over Royal Challengers Bengaluru in their IPL match on Friday. Sent in to bat, RCB posted 201 for 8, built around skipper Rajat Patidar’s 63, with Virat Kohli (32), Romario Shepherd (22) and Venkatesh Iyer (29) contributing. Sooryavanshi (78 off 26) and Jurel (81* off 43) added 108, before Jurel and Ravindra Jadeja (24) finished the chase. RR vs RCB IPL 2026 Live: Rajasthan Royals winRajasthan Royals win the battle of unbeatens. A ravishing innings from Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, followed by a finishing act by Dhruv Jurel, sealed a 6-wicket win for the Royals. Vaibhav, after a 15-ball fifty, scored a 26-ball 78, which included 7 sixes and 8 fours. Jurel, on the other hand, scored an unbeaten 81 off 43, hitting 3 maximums and 8 fours. A century partnership between Jurel and Sooryavanshi helped Rajasthan set the base, and then a fifty stand between Jurel and Ravindra Jadeja gave the finishing touches to the chase of 202. Rajasthan Royals won the game with 12 balls to spare. RR: 5/0 in 0.3 overs RR Vs RCB LIVE Score, IPL 2026 Match Today Updates: RCB set RR a target of 202!Royal Challengers Bengaluru posted 201/8 in their 20 overs at the Barsapara Stadium on Friday, with skipper Rajat Patidar’s half-century powering the innings after a rain delay. The hosts struck early after choosing to bowl, as Jofra Archer removed Phil Salt for a first-ball duck. Despite the early setback, Virat Kohli and Devdutt Padikkal gave RCB a brisk start, attacking the RR pacers with some help from luck. Padikkal was eventually dismissed by Archer, with Shimron Hetmyer taking a stunning catch. Ravi Bishnoi bowled Kohli for 32 off 16 balls, then struck again to remove Krunal Pandya for just 1, with Hetmyer completing another catch at long-off. Brijesh Sharma then sent Jitesh Sharma back for 5 and dismissed Tim David for 13. Romario Shepherd contributed 22 before falling to Ravindra Jadeja, after which impact player Venkatesh Iyer joined captain Patidar, who continued to keep the scoreboard moving. Patidar brought up a sparkling half-century and took RCB past 150 before Sandeep Sharma dismissed him for 63 off 40 balls. Venkatesh Iyer remained unbeaten on 29 and lifted RCB beyond the 200-run mark with a six off the final ball of the innings.
